_doc: Frontend contract for the Apex tier board movement slot. `score` is ALS pick share (%) on the band's board(s); `delta.dir` already applies the dead band + 2-day confirmation (render arrows only when dir != flat). `editorialTier` is the published letter (source of truth for the board); `autoTier` is a pick-share-only quantile letter for the WoW chart and must not replace the editorial tier. Built by scripts/guides/apex_tier_snapshot.py.

source.name: Apex Legends Status
source.label: apexlegendsstatus.com
source.definition: pick share = % of players active this season whose currently selected legend is X (ALS). Top-players board: share of tracked games; 'win' = games with positive RP, season to date.
